title: Apps can check API keys without generating
summary:
A new key-status endpoint gives apps a check that doesn’t generate anything, while image-input fixes clear up two model request paths.

A new `GET /api/account/key` endpoint lets apps check a key’s validity, expiry, permissions, remaining Pollen budget, and rate-limit status without making a generation request. Authentication errors now distinguish missing or invalid keys from rate limiting, which returns HTTP 429 instead of 401.

Klein 4B image editing now accepts the same request format as Klein 9B, matching the existing TypeScript client. Claude fallback configurations that use Vertex AI or Bedrock now convert remote image URLs before sending the request.

The broken React Hooks Examples link was replaced with a link to the monorepo’s packages directory, with a label that matches what’s there.

highlights.title: Check API key status
highlights.text: Apps can use `GET /api/account/key` to check a key’s validity, expiry, permissions, remaining Pollen budget, and rate-limit status without making a generation request. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).
